Follow these rules:
- Preserve the user's requested subjects, identities, actions, dialogue, lyrics, visible text, reference roles, endpoint frames, timing, and audio intent. Never replace or contradict them.
- Write in English except for dialogue and lyrics inside <d>[Language] ...</d> and text visibly present in the scene. Preserve their original wording and language.
- Treat an attached image as optional visual evidence. Use its visible appearance, composition, and style only where the manual draft assigns that role. Do not silently turn it into a first or last frame.
- Make the video chronological and physically observable. For every shot, establish composition, subject appearance and position, environment and lighting, action and state changes, camera behavior, and synchronized sound.
- [Shot 1] has no timestamp. Later shots begin with [Shot N] At MM:SS.mmm and strictly increasing cut times inside the stated duration.

- Keep ambience, physical action sounds, and non-verbal human sounds in overall_soundscape. Put only audience-only score in non_diegetic_music. Use N/A when there is no such score.

[Shot 1] The video opens in a vibrant 2D anime style. Bathed in warm golden-hour sunlight streaming through a left-side window, a young woman (S1) stands at a cozy, highly detailed kitchen stove. She has brown hair tied in a high ponytail, wearing a light blue knitted sweater and a white apron decorated with colorful flowers. Holding a wooden spoon, she gently stirs a steaming pot resting on a lit blue gas burner. Thick steam billows upward, catching the golden light. A calico cat sits patiently by her legs on the bottom right. The camera remains in a static medium shot. The woman sways slightly, visibly humming a cheerful tune as she stirs the stew.
[Shot 2] At 06:00.000, the camera cuts to a close-up of the woman's face and upper body. She lifts the wooden spoon, blowing softly on the hot broth before taking a delicate sip. Her eyes close briefly in satisfaction. Suddenly, a pair of masculine hands and arms reach into the frame from behind, wrapping affectionately around her waist. (S1) opens her eyes wide in brief surprise, her cheeks flushing with a deeper pink blush. She then relaxes her shoulders, leaning back slightly into the embrace, and turns her head halfway over her shoulder with a sweet, coquettish smile. She speaks affectionately, <d>[Japanese] もう、まだお料理中なんだから。</d> The camera remains steady on this intimate moment, with the soft steam continuing to rise in the foreground until the 14-second mark.

The continuous, rhythmic sizzling and bubbling of stew boiling in a pot, accompanied by the gentle clinking of a wooden spoon against the metal cookware. A cheerful, rhythmic female humming melody (S1) fills the room. Later, a soft blowing of air and a subtle sipping sound occur. Warm fabric rustling is heard as a man's arms embrace the woman from behind, seamlessly transitioning into the clear, coquettish female voice (S1) delivering the Japanese dialogue. Subtle, distant evening ambiance, such as faint chirping birds, softly layers the background.
